POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

# The url header parameter must match the request URL.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header url "https://magnolia.test/acme/account/other"
error == unauthorized

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header url "https://example.com/acme/account/other"
error == unauthorized

# URL integrity includes the query string.
POST-as-GET $account.url?query=1
sign header url "$account.url"
error == unauthorized

# The signature must be by the account key.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign key account2
error == unauthorized

POST $dir.newAccount as account3
sign key account2
payload {}
error == unauthorized

# Only ML-DSA algorithms are supported.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header alg "ES256"
error == badSignatureAlgorithm
$body.algorithms == ["ML-DSA-44","ML-DSA-65","ML-DSA-87"]

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header alg "none"
error == badSignatureAlgorithm

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header alg "ML-DSA-65"
error == malformed

POST $dir.newAccount as account3
sign header alg "ML-DSA-65"
payload {}
error == badPublicKey

# Unknown and non-string header parameters are rejected.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header alg 1
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header crit ["url"]
error == malformed

# Exactly one of kid and jwk is required.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header jwk $account.jwk
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header kid ""
error == malformed

# A syntactically valid JWK with an invalid public key is rejected.
POST $dir.newAccount as account3
sign header jwk {"kty":"AKP","alg":"ML-DSA-44","pub":"AAAA"}
payload {}
error == badPublicKey

# A null url is a missing url, which is a mismatch.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header url null
error == unauthorized

# Requests must be JWS with the right Content-Type.
POST $dir.newAccount
reqheader Content-Type application/json
payload {}
error == malformed
$code == 415

POST $dir.newAccount
reqheader Content-Type
payload {}
error == malformed
$code == 415

POST $dir.newAccount
reqheader Content-Type application/jose+json; charset=utf-8
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
$code == 200

POST $dir.newAccount
body not a JWS
error == malformed

POST $dir.newAccount
body {"protected":"","payload":"","signature":""}
error == malformed
